articles.title: New Raptive Survey: A Familiar Source Can Nearly Double Consumer Trust in an AI Answer
articles.description: In a new Raptive survey of 3,083 U.S. consumers, 74% said knowing the source behind an AI answer or recommendation was extremely or very important. Who that source was made a difference. Trust in an answer was 42% when no source was shown and 41.8% when the source was unfamiliar. It rose to 75.4% when the answer was tied to a creator or expert respondents already knew and trusted, and 77.2% when tied to a trusted publisher or media brand.
